title: Technology Sector Update for 02/08/2018: TWTR,SMI,SNCR
text:

Technology stocks were losing significant ground on Thursday, with shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 posting a nearly 1.7% decline while the Philadelphia semiconductor index was falling almost 2.6%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
+ Twitter ( TWTR ) rose to its highest price since July 2015, climbing over 30% to $35.00 a share, after the micro-blogging website recorded a Q4 adjusted profit, earning $0.19 per share and beat the Capital IQ consensus by $0.05 per share. Total revenue climbed to $731.6 million $717.2 million last year, also surpassing the analyst mean looking for $686.1 million. The results were buoyed by a 12% year-over-year increase in daily active users as well as product enhancements that helped sales execution.
In other sector news:
+ Semiconductor Manufacturing ( SMI ) still was narrowly higher Thursday afternoon following the chipmaker reporting Q4 net income exceeding Wall Street expectations. Excluding one-time items, the company earned $0.05 per share, down from $0.11 during the same period last year but still beating the Capital IQ consensus by $0.02 per share. Total revenue fell to $787.2 million from $814.8 million last year, lagging the $789.9 million analyst mean. The company also is expecting revenue to rise between 7% to 9% over Q4 levels, implying a range of $842.3 million to $860.5 million. Analysts, on average, are looking for $794.2 million in revenue.
- Synchronoss Technologies ( SNCR ) fell despite the Nasdaq Hearings Panel granting an extension to the company in its bid to regain compliance with the stock exchange's listing standards for timely filing of its quarterly reports. Synchronoss now has until May 10 to become current with all of its regulatory reports. It also is subject to the company providing period updates about its ongoing efforts to restate its prior financial results.
